venue_parking.q: Does Van Phat Riverside have parking?
venue_parking.a: Free parking for motorbikes, cars, and coaches is available in front of Hall 1.

parking.a: Yes. Motorbike parking costs VND 7,000 if you collect your vehicle before 6:00 PM, and VND 14,000 after 6:00 PM.

activities.q: What can I do while visiting Cần Thơ?

items.loto: Lô tô show — usually held on weekends around 6:30 PM at 45 Lê Lợi, Cái Khế Ward.
items.mykhanh: A group orchard experience with traditional ditch fishing at Mỹ Khánh.
items.floating_market: Visit Cái Răng Floating Market and the rice-noodle pizza workshop — shared boat tickets from Ninh Kiều Wharf are around VND 100,000–150,000 per person.
items.conson: Visit Cồn Sơn for an orchard and local community experience.
